scope_decision.included: same-currency standalone supplier bills; same-currency Commerce fulfillment matched bills; Procurement match post/void with variance and notifications; posted void; payable evidence; desktop/mobile UI.
scope_decision.excluded: native foreign-currency Commerce goods-carrying/FX posting and matched void.
scope_decision.retained_consumer: The retained command is postInvoice in packages/server-finance/src/adapters/finance.ts, reached through the payables post route legacy branch. It is the named consumer for foreign-currency matched payables; removal condition is the native Commerce goods-carrying/FX port.
scope_decision.follow_up: Native FX post/void is a separate Commerce owner bundle and is not counted as native payables evidence.
scope_decision.process_waiver: The user directed continued execution without a 6-subagent roster or Common frozen bundle. The gap is reported and is not used as evidence for this certification.

native_paths.http: The private Finance API mounts supplier-bill create/edit/post/void/detail, matched Procurement lifecycle, notifications and the HTTP business error contract.
native_paths.ssr: Finance invoice list/detail, posting form, draft/posted void and matched-void actions use the native owner paths.
native_paths.procurement: Finance validates the reviewed match, every active receipt version and the posted goods journal in one serializable unit; posts clearing/variance/tax/payable lines; advances the match with an event and Collaboration notification; returns the match on void with receipt deactivation and Commerce fulfillment release.
native_paths.money: The posting unit retains the Finance draft:v1 Money snapshot, copies it to total with carried source evidence, and keeps the invoice version/CAS and audit receipt.
native_paths.fx: Native Finance rejects foreign-currency commerce before writes; the retained legacy goods-carrying FX path is the named consumer.
